svg.title: Where the frontier sits among the top models
svg.text: Where the frontier sits among the top models
The top 15 models scored by at least 2 of 5 suites, on the same scale. Outlined settings sit on the frontier.
On the frontier: scores higher than every cheaper setting shown

g.text: Relative cost per task (1 = a typical charted setting), log scale
Combined quality (50 = the average charted setting)

svg.text: One line per model, joining its efforts from lowest to highest. A dash pattern tells one provider's models apart. Coloured lines are the models this page routes; grey dotted lines are the rest.
Bold names have at least one setting on the frontier.
The number beside a name counts the suites that scored it at any effort, of 5. Superseded releases are left out. Data read 2026-11-25.
Suites: FrontierCode 2.0, VulcanBench v4, AA Index without coding v5.0.2, Vals Index 2.2, CursorBench 4.1.
